name: Goal24 Checkpoint 4 Lane A - GitHub CLI Read-Only Adapter Core
base_note: origin/dev/goal24-cli-skills, verified exact after git fetch --all --tags --prune
commit_sha_note: docs commit that records this checkpoint (the manifest itself is committed as the branch tip immediately after)

commits.message: test(github-cli): harden argv and output parsing
docs(goal24): record cp4 github adapter lane

capabilities_implemented.argv: gh pr view <number> --repo=<owner/repo> --json=<hardcoded fields incl. statusCheckRollup>

executable_trust.source: trusted Rust bootstrap/discovery only; never from WebView, IPC caller, LLM, ExecutionPlan or normalized_inputs
executable_trust.constructor_validation: absolute, canonicalizable, exists, regular file, extension exactly .exe on Windows (.cmd/.bat/.ps1 rejected)
executable_trust.path_discovery: pure filesystem scan; only concrete absolute ...\gh.exe candidates; never outranks higher-priority sources; bare gh never handed to broker
executable_trust.spawn_time: broker resolver re-validates and fingerprints before every spawn; no OS PATH lookup at spawn

argv_policy.mechanism: compiled binding code only; Vec<OsString>; no join/split/shell parsing; no cmd /C / powershell / bash / sh
argv_policy.caller_controlled: never: flag names, subcommands, JSON fields, --jq, --template, --web, --hostname
argv_policy.nul_rejection: adapter-level for query and paths plus broker reject_nul_args before spawn

input_validation.owner_repo: trimmed, non-empty, max 100 chars, rejects . / .. / leading - / control / whitespace / '/' / '\'
input_validation.query: max 1024 chars, only NUL rejected; spaces, CRLF, leading dashes and Unicode remain one data value

output_parsing.gate: cancelled=false, timed_out=false, success=true, exit_code=Some(0), stdout_truncated=false before any JSON parse
output_parsing.auth: exit code 4 maps to GH_AUTH_NOT_READY (gh documented auth exit)
output_parsing.generic_failure: other non-zero exits map to GH_CLI_FAILED; English stderr never parsed
output_parsing.json: strict serde_json::from_str; partial/trailing JSON rejected; missing required fields -> GH_JSON_INVALID
output_parsing.reserved_codes_note: GH_*_NOT_FOUND codes are declared but never emitted in CP4 (gh uses generic exit 1); reserved for a future structured probe

cwd_policy.mechanism: adapter-owned github_cli_work_root created and canonicalized at construction
cwd_policy.derive_cwd: ignores normalized_inputs entirely; always returns the work root
cwd_policy.repo_selection: explicit --repo / owner+repo; never the current git repository

env_policy.mechanism: broker env_clear() + minimal base (SystemRoot, TEMP, TMP on Windows) + binding allowlist
env_policy.fail_safe_strip: broker strips forbidden secret names even if allowlisted

auth_boundary.note: CP3 broker also refuses execution when GITHUB_TOKEN is present in its own environment

broker_contract_touches: execution_broker/mod.rs: one-token additive re-export of OutputLimits so the trait's return type is nameable outside the private policy module (no semantic change)
main.rs: #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))] mod github_cli; declaration only, same pattern CP3 used for execution_broker (no invoke handler, no runtime effect)

tests.suite: src/github_cli/tests.rs (pure; no process spawn, no network, no remote state changes)
coverage: exact argv snapshots for all five capabilities

result.note: ignored test is the pre-existing broker child-protocol fixture; 52 new github_cli tests all pass

verification.cargo_check: PASS (only pre-existing clipboard.rs dead-code warning from base)
verification.cargo_clippy_all_targets: PASS (zero warnings in github_cli; only pre-existing base warnings)

cargo_audit.note: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock untouched; findings are the pre-existing CP3 baseline set

verification.verify_controlled: PASS; snapshot regenerated for the disclosed main.rs declaration via the repo's sanctioned snapshot workflow

known_residual_risks: Adapter core compiles and registers but nothing executes it in production yet; execution-path integration, real-environment gh/auth checks and network behavior belong to CP4 Integration / Lane C
Not-found classification (GH_REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND etc.) is reserved; gh exit code 1 currently maps to GH_CLI_FAILED
Discovery validation checks path shape/existence, not binary provenance; broker pre-spawn fingerprint remains the control (CP3 TOCTOU residual risk unchanged)
Broker-wide non-zero-exit semantics intentionally unchanged; gh pr checks deliberately not used (would need a broker exit-semantics change)
controlled-files snapshot hashes raw on-disk bytes and is sensitive to line-ending checkout state; regenerated and verified green in this worktree

environment.policy: D: first, then existing C:; new installs only under D:\environment
environment.github_cli_installed: not installed by this lane (Lane C owns the GitHub CLI environment audit)
